facts.fact: Z. Mayet and Associates state that Lesotho signed the African Union Malabo Convention on 30 November 2023.
facts.system: Malabo Convention (AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection)

facts.fact: The firm states Lesotho has not yet ratified the Convention per the AU status list last updated 8 July 2024.

facts.fact: The firm describes the cross-border transfer rules of Lesotho's Data Protection Act No. 5 of 2012 as SADC-model-inspired; the Act's year is used as the date, the article being from 2025-10-31.
